checks.title: Memory
items: `retain`/`release` imbalance under manual reference counting; `__weak` used without a strong check.
Block captures of `self` creating a retain cycle (`self` captured strongly in a long-lived block).

checks.title: Runtime
items: Messaging a possibly-nil pointer where the result is dereferenced (a nil return silently becomes 0/nil).
Selectors performed without `respondsToSelector:` on a protocol-typed object.
Dictionary subscripting with a nil key.

examples.note: nil message becomes 0, hiding the failure
